purpose: Define a bounded, privacy-aware projection from Book System canonical version/provenance evidence into interoperable external provenance representations without transferring internal authority, replacing the parent ledger, or making external provenance standards mandatory runtime dependencies.

verified_properties: prov:Entity represents a physical, digital, conceptual or other thing with fixed aspects
prov:Activity represents an activity that uses, transforms or generates entities
prov:Agent represents responsibility for an activity, entity or another agent's activity
prov:used and prov:wasGeneratedBy connect activities and entities
prov:wasAssociatedWith and prov:wasAttributedTo represent responsibility relationships
qualified derivations and roles are available when a simple relationship would lose material context
Content Credentials provide cryptographically verifiable provenance assertions bound to an asset
C2PA validation establishes tamper-evidence and signer/assertion integrity under its trust model; it does not itself judge whether asserted provenance is good, bad or factually true
creators and publishers should retain control over which provenance data is included
hard bindings can cryptographically bind a manifest to an exact asset
update manifests and redaction mechanisms can support bounded provenance changes without silently rewriting history
C2PA 2.4 supports document-oriented formats including PDF and ZIP-based formats such as EPUB and OOXML

canonical_authority.rule: The Book System parent ledger, immutable canonical object versions, exact digests, admission receipts, author decisions and lifecycle receipts remain the only canonical authority for Book System state.

rules: Projection is derived from an exact immutable parent-ledger snapshot and never from floating latest pointers.
Only claims directly supported by admitted internal evidence may be projected.
Unknown, disputed, abstained, partial, stale or explicitly unverified claims retain that status or are omitted; they may not be normalized into certainty.
Projection creation never mutates the source ledger or canonical manuscript.
A projection that cannot preserve required role, uncertainty, rights or privacy semantics fails closed rather than broadening the claim.

agent_mapping.RESEARCH_PROVIDER: prov:Agent or prov:SoftwareAgent according to actual actor

relationship_mapping: New immutable manuscript versions use prov:wasRevisionOf and/or prov:wasDerivedFrom only where internal lineage proves that relationship.
Activities use prov:used for exact input entities and generated outputs use prov:wasGeneratedBy.
Activities use prov:wasAssociatedWith for the actual responsible human/system/tool roles supported by evidence.
prov:wasAttributedTo is used only when internal evidence supports attribution; file generation by a software tool must not be confused with human authorship of book content.
Qualified derivation and qualified association are required when roles, transformation type, source version or tool identity would otherwise be ambiguous.
External projection identifiers must include or resolve to the Book System immutable object/version/digest identities needed to reconcile the projection back to internal evidence.

authorship_separation.content_authorship: Represent only from explicit author/editor evidence and author-decision history.
authorship_separation.artifact_generation: Represent separately as document/export activity associated with the Document System/toolchain.
authorship_separation.evaluation_or_ai_assistance: Represent as separate activities/agents when disclosure policy authorizes it; assistance does not automatically become authorship.
authorship_separation.publication_authority: Represent only from explicit Book System publication/delivery authorization evidence.

c2pa_projection.execution_owner: DOCUMENT SYSTEM or a separately governed provenance/signing provider; Book System supplies the bounded provenance projection and acceptance policy but does not implement a duplicate credential-embedding engine.
required_book_side_request: exact source manuscript version and digest
publication_authorized flag sourced only from explicit Book System authority
required_response_evidence: signer identity or signer-class evidence permitted by privacy policy
c2pa_projection.digest_rule: If attaching or embedding a Content Credential changes asset bytes, Book System must store a new final credentialed-artifact digest after attachment. A pre-credential export digest remains a predecessor identity and must not be silently reused as the final asset digest.
claim_boundary: A valid Content Credential proves the bounded signed provenance assertions and content binding under the C2PA trust model; it does not prove literary quality, factual truth, authorship beyond the signer/attribution evidence, author approval, canonical admission or publication authorization.
C2PA assertions must never be broader than internal admitted evidence.
Private manuscript text, hidden evaluation evidence, private research material, personal data or internal deliberation is excluded unless explicitly authorized and required.
Use identifiers, digests, transformation classes and bounded public metadata in preference to raw private content.
C2PA remains optional internally even when a particular release profile requires a credential on the outgoing asset.

classes.PUBLIC_METADATA_ALLOWED: Project bounded metadata authorized for release.
classes.EXPLICIT_CONTENT_DISCLOSURE_ALLOWED: Project content only under explicit rights/privacy authorization and a release requirement.

fail_closed_conditions: requested provenance claim exceeds admitted evidence
requested signer/author attribution lacks explicit supporting evidence
projection would expose protected manuscript text or evidence unnecessarily
external format cannot preserve a material uncertainty/disagreement boundary

supersession_invalidation_and_redaction.source_version_changes: An existing projection remains historical evidence for the exact old source/artifact it describes but becomes SUPERSEDED_FOR_CURRENT_RELEASE. A new canonical manuscript or artifact requires a new projection; old provenance must never be rebound to new bytes or a new source digest.
supersession_invalidation_and_redaction.internal_evidence_reclassified: If rights, privacy, attribution or evidence validity changes, Book System records the new internal state first. External correction, redaction, update-manifest or revocation action is then requested where supported and appropriate; immutable prior evidence is not silently rewritten.
supersession_invalidation_and_redaction.artifact_changes: Any changed artifact bytes require new artifact identity/digest and revalidation of the external binding.
supersession_invalidation_and_redaction.publication_withdrawal: Withdrawal or supersession is a Book System release-state fact. External credential status may reflect it when supported, but cannot substitute for the parent ledger.
supersession_invalidation_and_redaction.chain_rule: Every external successor must retain enough predecessor identity to reconcile the lineage without implying that the predecessor remains current.

must_not_do: replace the Book System parent ledger with W3C PROV, C2PA or another external provenance standard
make C2PA or W3C PROV a mandatory internal dependency for authoring or canonical state changes
allow an imported external provenance document to mutate canonical Book state without normal parent intake/admission
equate a C2PA signature or validation PASS with factual truth, literary quality, authorship, author approval or publication authority
expose raw private manuscript text or private evidence solely to create provenance metadata
collapse human author, editor, AI/service provider, document renderer and publisher into one generic agent role
silently rebind an old provenance projection to a new manuscript version or changed artifact digest
allow the Document System or provenance provider to infer Book canonical admission or publication status

KEEP: Book System immutable parent ledger as canonical authority
artifact digests and immutable predecessor lineage
ADD_OR_REFINE: pre-credential versus final credentialed-artifact digest distinction
DO_NOT_ADD: automatic public disclosure of private authoring/evaluation history
provenance signature as truth or publication authorization
UNRESOLVED: Exact C2PA signer credential/trust-list policy is deployment/distribution-context dependent and remains a later release-infrastructure decision.
Whether a specific distributor requires or strips Content Credentials must be checked at release time and must not be hard-coded into Book core architecture.

integration_runtime_rereview_requirement: Preserve provenance/evidence refs and exact source/provider/projection identity through intake and proposal snapshots.
Ensure imported external provenance is evidence-only until normal parent admission rules are satisfied.
Ensure Document/Export provider success and external credential validation cannot imply publication authorization.
Ensure stale/superseded provenance cannot advance a proposal without explicit parent revalidation.
Ensure rights/privacy changes can stale or reject affected proposals without erasing historical evidence.
Ensure any external provenance attachment remains downstream of canonical state and cannot create a backdoor canonical write path.
qualification_effect: NONE. This artifact defines research-verified architecture/projection law only. It creates no C2PA credential, W3C PROV export, executable provenance adapter, canonical mutation, publication authority or runtime qualification.
